response.original_title: Solve-it Squad: How the Grunch Cribbed Christmas
response.overview: Welcome to the 1st Annual Holly Jolly Toy Drive and Nondenominational Winter Pageant Slash Variety Show (“Holly Jolly”)! Scrags, Keith, and Esther have been recruited by Gwen to host an evening of special guests, music, and fundraising! Together, these four make up the Solve It Squad, Mayberry’s premier former kid detective gang. An ambitious narcissist, a loveable doofus, a skittish sad-sap, and a scheming brainiac… What could go wrong???
